notes: Go only. The focused porter for Pi TypeScript extensions: the strict porting Skill plus the equivalence harness as a fused Go extension. Run npm run stage before using its generated manifest under dist/staged.
Most users who port extensions want this Piglet rather than pig-porter, which extends it. Its Packages (extension-port, extension-equivalence) also install on their own with pig install.

A Piglet Binary builds locally from the staged manifest with PIG_SOURCE_ROOT set to a git checkout of the PiG source. Signed Binaries for the five manifest targets are published as GitHub Release pig-extension-porter/v0.1.1 (built natively by the release workflow; pull one with pig piglet pull github:MichaelKinsy/pigpen/pig-extension-porter@0.1.1); the local runs in this repository are linux/amd64 only, and no platform is a support claim.
